analysis.reasonEn: After the previous buy signal, a wait-and-see approach was maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. Today, RSI is at 66.0, consolidating in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram improvement continues. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low of $0.23 being higher than the 20-day low of $0.19. All SMAs (SMA5 $0.25, SMA20 $0.22, SMA50 $0.21, SMA100 $0.19, SMA200 $0.21) are above the price, maintaining bullish alignment. Weekly RSI is 52.6 and weekly ADX is 30.9, indicating good trend strength. The 4-hour RSI is 62.2 with improving MACD histogram. The price is at 15.1% of its 52-week range, indicating a recovery phase from the lows. A breakout above the swing resistance of $0.26 is expected to lead to further upside.
